sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.snippet: The model delivers strong document parsing performance while maintaining a small deployment footprint. OvisOCR2 achieves an overall score of 96.58 on OmniDocBench v1.6, establishing a new state of the art and becoming the first end-to-end model to top this leaderboard previously dominated by pipeline methods.
